metaDesc: Ḍfuṛ azmz n‑Lɛahd Aqdim, tudrt n‑yasuɛ, d‑isafarn n‑Bulus f‑yan‑ukard n‑tidt — Lkitab ijra ġ‑imukan n‑tidt.

s.title: Lkitab s‑ukard
s.verse: “ur‑a‑nbnnu f‑kra n‑tḥajiyin tyawskarnin s‑lɛaql n‑bnadm ġakud lliġ‑awn‑nsawl f‑mamnk a‑d‑yuška siditnnġ yasuɛ lmasiḥ s‑tḥkimt itjhhdn. ašku nkkʷni nẓra timuġra‑ns,” (2 Buṭrus 1:16)
s.purpose: Lkitab urd tah̬kayt n‑tkrkas. Iga tira f‑mddn lli‑ftan ġ‑imukan, izmaz, d‑ismawn n‑tidt. Ḍfuṛ iɣarasn‑an ġ‑ukard, s‑umizwar n‑uzmz — ut ġ‑yat‑tnqqiḍt, nġd ut ▶ baš a‑tzrit srs asurif s‑usurif.
s.ot_lead: Urd yan‑usafar ɣir yan, walaynni azray n‑umzruy n‑unjjam zġ‑lh̬lq s‑dat: lh̬lq d‑uṭṭiy → ṭṭufan d‑Babil → tiɣri (Ibrahim) → tamazirt n‑lwaɛd → Affuɣ → lh̬la → akšam → tagldit → abḍu → ah̬bas → tuɣalin.
s.je_lead: Ḍfuṛ tudrt n‑yasuɛ zund ma‑tt‑ttinin linjilat, s‑umizwar — zġ‑talalit‑ns ġ‑Bayt Laḥm, s‑usddam‑ns d‑lh̬dmt‑ns ġ‑Jalil, s‑Samira, ar‑uggjdi, ankar, d‑uɣulli s‑ujnna ġ‑Urušalim.
s.pa_lead: Zġ‑lɛnṣart ġ‑Urušalim, mamnk a‑izduy lh̬bar ifulkin berra n‑Yahuda — s‑Asya Tamẓyant d‑Uruppa ar‑wul n‑tgldit tameqqrant. Sti yan zġ‑smmus n‑isafarn (amzwaru·wis sin·wis kraḍ + asafar s‑Ruma + awddi n‑tlelli), tḍfuṛt tigawin n‑Lh̬rakat n‑imazann d‑tbratin lli‑ityaran ġ‑uɣaras.
s.foot: Iɣbula · Imukan ar‑ḍfuṛn awal n‑Lkitab d‑ljuɣrafiya ittwassann n‑Lkitab (s‑ismawn n‑ġilad mani a‑ġ‑infaɛ). Tama n‑lbḥr, isaffn, d‑iglman ttwasunɣn zġ‑isfka n‑ljuɣrafiya iyrzimn (Natural Earth), ttwashaln.
